SPA_CONFIG_URLS or O3 will not read it (IMPLEMENTATION.md §7).

_comment_epartograph: The e-partograph is a Custom Build ESM pinned in distribution/distro.properties.
Its clinical concepts are supplied here rather than compiled into the module, so
a concept correction ships as a config change, not a frontend release.
